papers.title: Effect of heat-treatment temperature on microstructures and mechanical properties of Co–Cr–Mo alloys fabricated by selective laser melting
papers.first_author_affiliation: Removable Partial Prosthodontics, Oral Health Sciences, Graduate School of Medical and Dental Sciences, Tokyo Medical and Dental University, 1-5-45 Yushima, Bunkyo-ku, Tokyo 113-8549, Japan

corresponding_authors.name: Atsushi Takaichi
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Removable Partial Prosthodontics, Oral Health Sciences, Graduate School of Medical and Dental Sciences, Tokyo Medical and Dental University, 1-5-45 Yushima, Bunkyo-ku, Tokyo 113-8549, Japan

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了选区激光熔化Co-Cr-Mo合金的热处理工艺对微观结构和力学性能的影响，为生物医用植入物材料提供参考。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structure, stress shielding, fatigue behavior, or surface roughness relevant to osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究热处理温度对SLM成形Co-Cr-Mo合金组织与力学性能的影响
summary_zh.method: 采用SLM制备合金，进行不同温度热处理，表征微观组织并测试力学性能
summary_zh.result: 适当热处理显著提升合金的强度和延展性
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸和硬度测试验证力学性能改善

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of heat-treatment temperature on the microstructure and mechanical properties of Co-Cr-Mo alloys fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Co-Cr-Mo samples were fabricated by SLM, subjected to various heat treatments, and characterized by microstructural analysis and mechanical testing.
summary_en.result: Appropriate heat treatment significantly improved the strength and ductility of the alloy.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through tensile and hardness tests.

papers.title: Selective laser melting of high strength and toughness stainless steel parts: The roles of laser hatch style and part placement strategy
papers.first_author_affiliation: College of Materials Science and Technology, Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics, Yudao Street 29, Nanjing 210016, Jiangsu Province, People's Republic of China

corresponding_authors.name: Dongdong Gu
corresponding_authors.affiliation: College of Materials Science and Technology, Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics, Yudao Street 29, Nanjing 210016, Jiangsu Province, People's Republic of China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究不锈钢的选区激光熔化工艺参数对力学性能的影响，未涉及生物医用植入物或多孔结构。
llm.why_not_core: No biomedical context, no porous structure, no stress shielding, no fatigue testing, no surface roughness or osseointegration assessment.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究激光扫描方式和零件放置策略对SLM不锈钢强度与韧性的影响。
summary_zh.method: 采用不同激光扫描方式和零件放置位置制备试样并进行力学测试。
summary_zh.result: 优化参数下可获得高强高韧的不锈钢零件。
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸、冲击和硬度测试验证力学性能。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effects of laser hatch style and part placement strategy on the strength and toughness of selective laser melted stainless steel parts.
summary_en.method: Specimens were fabricated using different laser hatch styles and part placements, followed by mechanical testing.
summary_en.result: Optimized processing parameters yielded stainless steel parts with high strength and toughness.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical properties were validated through tensile, impact, and hardness tests.

papers.title: Periprosthetic femoral fracture as cause of early revision after short stem hip arthroplasty—a multicentric analysis
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Korea University Guro Hospital, Korea University School of Medicine, Seoul, South Korea

corresponding_authors.name: Seung‐Jae Lim
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopedic Surgery, Samsung Medical Center, Sungkyunkwan University School of Medicine, 50 Irwon-dong, Gangnam-gu, Seoul, 135-710, South Korea. limsj70@gmail.com

llm.relevance_to_user: 这篇论文主要关注临床翻修原因，未涉及应力遮挡、微动或有限元建模。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a clinical analysis of periprosthetic fractures and does not quantify stress shielding, micromotion, or provide FEA boundary conditions.

summary_zh.motivation: 分析短柄髋关节置换术后早期翻修的原因
summary_zh.method: 多中心回顾性分析翻修病例
summary_zh.result: 发现假体周骨折是早期翻修的主要原因

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the causes of early revision after short-stem hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: A multicentric retrospective analysis of revision cases was conducted.
summary_en.result: Periprosthetic femoral fracture was identified as the leading cause of early revision.
summary_en.validation: Clinical data from multiple centers were statistically analyzed.

papers.title: INFLUENCE OF FEMORAL HEAD DIAMETER ON GAIT PARAMETERS AFTER HIP ARTHROPLASTY
papers.abstract: Background Hip resurfacing arthroplasty (HRA) and total hip arthroplasty (THA) are treatments of end-stage hip disease. Gait analysis studies comparing HRA and THA have demonstrated HRA results in ...

llm.relevance_to_user: 此论文为临床步态分析，不涉及髋关节假体的应力遮挡或微动分析，与用户研究方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not quantify stress shielding, micromotion, or contact mechanics; it uses clinical gait analysis not FE simulation.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究股骨头直径对全髋/表面置换术后步态的影响
summary_zh.method: 临床步态分析对比不同直径患者
summary_zh.result: 揭示了直径差异对步态参数的影响

summary_en.motivation: To investigate how femoral head diameter affects gait parameters after hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: Clinical gait analysis comparing patients with different head diameters.
summary_en.result: Demonstrated significant differences in selected gait parameters between groups.
summary_en.validation: Clinical gait data collection from human subjects.
